title: The World at War
overview: Laurence Olivier narrates the landmark 26-part British documentary series telling the story of World War II, profiling its main campaigns and highlighting the human cost on all sides of the conflict.

episodes.title: Genocide (1941 - 1945)
episodes.overview: The Nazi's are racist; the Aryans are a master race, others, particularly the Jews are sub-human. Himmler's SS sets about ridding Europe of millions of Jews. The Nazis kill 6 million Jews in specially created death camps in their determination to create a purified Aryan race.
